brief: Crack IT edit: 16:9 YouTube, no captions, Crack IT brand intro after the hook, SFX, cut audio mistakes; no BGM; English

list.name: terminal
list.brief: terminal / data-desk look: monospace, stepped plotter arrivals; graphic-led (flow diagrams, checklists, number rolls), b-roll sparse and docked; a beat every 5-7 s; crisp digital ticks and soft clicks for SFX

list.name: newsroom
list.brief: bold newsroom look: news screenshots and NewsCards lead, split-screen framing, oversized section numerals, high-contrast accents; punchy pace, a beat every 3-5 s; wipe whooshes and hits on section changes

list.name: explainer
list.brief: light product-explainer look: calm and clean, charts and comparison tables carry the numbers, generous white space, office/campus b-roll full frame between graphics; a beat every 6-8 s; soft, sparse SFX

list.name: liquid
list.brief: modern liquid-glass look for a young audience: glossy capsules, jelly-spring arrivals, slow push-ins on b-roll, keyword chips and stat trios; energetic, a beat every 3-5 s; airy swooshes and pops

list.name: story
list.brief: documentary storytelling look: full-frame b-roll leads, graphics docked to one side, quote pulls on the key lines, timelines for the backstory; slower, a beat every 6-10 s; low sub-band SFX on structure only
